tools.name: product-recalls__search
tools.description: Check a product, brand or ingredient across UK product recalls, MHRA alerts, FSA food alerts and US CPSC recalls in one call; newest first. Free within the daily allowance, then $0.003 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: product-recalls__uk-products
tools.description: OPSS product safety alerts, reports and recalls (toys, electricals, cosmetics…): risk level, category, measures taken (recall, withdrawal, marketplace takedown). Free within the daily allowance, then $0.002 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: product-recalls__uk-medical
tools.description: MHRA drug and medical device alerts: recalls, field safety notices and device safety information, with medical specialisms affected. Free within the daily allowance, then $0.002 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: product-recalls__uk-food
tools.description: Food Standards Agency allergy alerts, product recall information notices and food alerts for action, newest first. Free within the daily allowance, then $0.001 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: product-recalls__uk-food-alert
tools.description: One FSA alert in full: products, pack sizes, batch and best-before codes, allergens, risk, action taken and consumer advice. Free within the daily allowance, then $0.001 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: product-recalls__uk-accidents
tools.description: AAIB (air), MAIB (marine) or RAIB (rail) investigation reports and bulletins, newest first. Free within the daily allowance, then $0.002 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: product-recalls__us-products
tools.description: US CPSC recalls by product name, manufacturer, UPC or hazard (default: last 90 days), newest first, with units, remedies, retailers and country of manufacture. Free within the daily allowance, then $0.002 USDC per call via x402.
